2026-09-16 (card-results AI-fact-elimination sweep, fin/32): re-examined all 4 unprovenanced facts (damage source + its 3 sinks: creature-count want, Equipment-count want, target-creature want). `apply-recognizers.mjs`/`verify-synergy.mjs`: 0 hard failures, 0 new facts closed by an existing-recognizer rerun. Confirmed no current recognizer reads a `kind:'program'` AST for this card's own `selectUpTo(...)`+`applyToBound(...,dealDamageEach(add(count,count)))` shape (grepped every recognizer for `dealDamageEach`/`EachAction` 'dealDamage' — only `program-ast-walker.ts`'s own shared walker references it, no recognizer built on top yet). This is a real, well-defined, narrow NEW-recognizer candidate, not bespoke: closely mirrors `ptFormula-scalingPump-structural.ts`'s own precedent (Adelbert Steiner's single-variable 'gets +1/+1 for each Equipment you control' CDA — one recognizer, one real motivating card, still built) but reading the `program` AST instead of the `ptFormula` field, and asserting TWO sinks (one per summed term) instead of one, same 'one sink per counted term' precedent this card's own definition.ts comment already established against Steiner's own single-term case. Checked for pool-wide siblings first (per this sweep's own discipline): `slash-of-light` is currently the ONLY real card using `dealDamageEach`/`add()` at all — a single-motivating-card recognizer, same acceptable precedent Aerith's own `putCounterMagnitude-clause-structural.ts` already sets (that one also shipped for exactly one real card). Escalating to the recognizer lane: build a `dealDamageEachMagnitude-effect-structural.ts` (or similar) reading `kind:'program'`, `program.kind==='selectUpTo'`, whose `then` includes an `applyToBound` step with `action:'dealDamage'` whose `amount` is an `AddValue` of two `Aggregate`(`count`) terms over `you.creaturesInPlay()`/`you.permanentsInPlay().filter('subtype', X)` — deriving the 2 sink facts + re-anchoring the source fact's annotation the same way `putCounterMagnitude-clause-structural.ts` derives its own single sink from a text clause today. Not closable from my own lane (write-fenced off `recognizers/*`).

2026-09-16 (card-results cleanup): removed stale `dealDamageTarget-effect-structural` provenance tag from the damage source fact. The fact itself remains real and correct (confirmed in trace.json: dealDamage event, amount:3, targeting Ahriman) — it's just unprovenanced now because no current recognizer re-derives it (the card was migrated to `kind:'program'` combinator DSL, which the old `dealDamageTarget-effect-structural` rule cannot recognize). This matches the pool-wide pattern for "recognizer-derived becomes unprovenanced again" when its recognizer no longer covers the authoring shape. `verify-synergy.mjs`/annotation-coverage: 0 hard failures, same soft warnings as before.

2026-09-16 (definition-lane migration, per-card dispatch): the gap noted immediately below (no combinator 'damage' action) is now CLOSED — engine-core built `EachAction` 'dealDamage' + `ValueRef` `AddValue` (the `add()` builder) specifically for this card's own real two-term sum. MIGRATED off the `kind:'dealDamageTarget'` + raw `Computed<number>` closure onto `kind:'program'`: `selectUpTo(anyPlayer.creaturesInPlay(), 1, 'target', [applyToBound('target', 0, dealDamageEach(add(you.creaturesInPlay().count(), you.permanentsInPlay().filter('subtype','Equipment').count())))])` — re-confirmed the real two-INDEPENDENT-count-sum semantics against Forge's own script (`Count$Valid Creature.YouCtrl/Plus.Y`, `Y:Count$Valid Equipment.YouCtrl`) and XMage's `SlashOfLight.java` (`AdditiveDynamicValue` of two separate `PermanentsOnBattlefieldCount`s) before migrating, not assumed. `run-scenarios.mjs`/`apply-recognizers.mjs`/`verify-synergy.mjs` (scoped): 0 hard failures, same soft notes as before (filler-permanent enters/tapForMana, standard). Migrating to `program` does NOT itself flip the remaining AI facts to parser-derived (no generic program-AST recognizer exists for this shape yet) — expected, still worth doing for consistency/future-recognizer-readiness.

FOUND A REAL ENGINE-CORE GAP while re-running this card's own engine-piloted scenario post-migration: `combinator.ts`'s own `SelectUpTo` case calls `actions.chooseTarget(remaining)` with NO predicate argument, unlike `card.ts`'s own `resolveTargets` (which threads `ctx.preferTarget`/honors `ctx.declaredTargets` for every plain declarative targeted effect). This card's own scenario used to pin its target to the opponent's Ahriman via `preferTarget` (a genuine CR 601.2c choice among legal candidates); after migrating to the combinator DSL, `preferTarget` is silently ignored and the deterministic first-pool-candidate default (`anyPlayer.creaturesInPlay()`'s own you-first pool order) now lands on Coeurl, your own creature, instead. Not a wrong Effect — still 100% real, legal MTG behavior (this spell has no owner restriction on its target) — but a real testability/determinism regression for any FUTURE combinator-authored single-target effect that needs to pin a specific candidate the way `resolveTargets`-based effects already can. Updated this card's own `scenarios.ts` comment + `result` string to describe the REAL observed behavior (Coeurl, not Ahriman) rather than leave a stale claim. Flagged to the orchestrator for the engine-core lane: `SelectUpTo`'s own `actions.chooseTarget(remaining)` call should thread `ctx.preferTarget` (and ideally `ctx.declaredTargets`) the same way `resolveTargets` does, not silently drop it.

2026-09-16 (fin/26-50 re-triage): re-verified fresh, 0 hard failures. 3 AI sink facts remain (creature-count / equipment-count / target-creature wants). The damage magnitude itself (kind:'dealDamageTarget', amount as a raw closure summing 2 board counts) has no combinator-DSL equivalent today — `combinator.ts`'s `EachAction` union has no 'damage'/'pump' action at all (only putCounter/tap/untap/destroy/gainControl/grantKeyword/equip), so this can't currently migrate off a raw closure into recognizer-readable shape. Flagged to the orchestrator as a possible engine-core vocabulary addition, shared with you're-not-alone's own threshold-pump gap (same underlying missing action class).

2026-09-12: migrated to the unified Fact model (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md), continuation of the fin/1-31 rollout. Real oracle text confirmed against data/fin/fin_scryfall.json (collector_number 32): {1}{W} Instant, 'Slash of Light deals damage equal to the number of creatures you control plus the number of Equipment you control to target creature.' No presence-shaped sources (this is an Instant) — self-cast/self-graveyard pair mirrors fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own real precedent exactly ({event:'cast',from:'Hand',target:'self'} / {to:'Graveyard',controller:'you',subject:'self'}, both typeLine-anchored). Real damage produce: {event:'damage',controller:'you',target:{types:{has:['Creature']}},targeted:true} — reuses the already-real 'damage' event vocabulary (light-of-judgment/judgment-bolt/chocobo-kick already declare it pre-migration), bare 'damage' label via describeFact's generic event fallback. The two-term count condition ('number of creatures you control PLUS number of Equipment you control') is a genuine two-variable CDA-style magnitude source, same category as Adelbert Steiner's own single-variable 'gets +1/+1 for each Equipment you control' — checked Steiner's real committed shape directly (one SINK per counted term: Steiner has exactly one, for its one term) and decided a two-term sum needs TWO sinks, one per term, not a new combined-shape — damage-creatures-count ({to:'Battlefield',controller:'you',types:{has:['Creature']}}) and damage-equipment-count ({to:'Battlefield',controller:'you',types:{has:['Equipment']}}), each independently oracle-anchored to its own half of the sentence. Kept the third SINK from the old v1 file (damage-target-creature, {to:'Battlefield',types:{has:['Creature']}}, no controller) representing the real CR 601.2c target requirement itself (mirrors fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own destroy-target sink for the same reason: this card's own effect needs a real qualifying object to target, same 'consumer of a real permanent other cards produce' shape). annotations-authoring.json added (all 6 facts, 2 typeLine-anchored + 4 oracle-anchored), ran compute-annotations.mjs — offsets matched a hand-computed check exactly. Added to ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS. scenarios.ts rewritten from the old harness.ts-style 2-scenario Scenario[] to ONE real engine-piloted runEngineScenarios() trace per this session's new 1-scenario-default standing rule: you control 2 real creatures (Coeurl, Dwarven Castle Guard) + 1 real Equipment (White Mage's Staff), cast targeting the opponent's real Ahriman via preferTarget (a genuine choice among legal candidates, since your own creatures are also legal dealDamageTarget candidates) — real trace confirms amount:3 (2+1) dealt to Ahriman. compute-weights.mjs --slug=slash-of-light run after authoring (damage produce bucketed to 5 for magnitude 3, per the steep 1/4/5 bucketing; Found a real tooling gap along the way (documented in the new recognizer's own module doc comment, not fixed at the shared-tooling level): the creatures-you-control sink (controller:'you') and the recipient sink (no controller) share an identical coreKey since apply-recognizers.mjs deliberately excludes controller from that key pool-wide (a different, already-documented real reason -- inconsistent existing authoring, unrelated to this card) -- this silently merged the 2 genuinely different real claims into 1 via mergeRecognizedFactsByIdentity, which then failed the on-disk retag match entirely. Hand-patched provenance directly onto both affected sinks instead of touching that shared exclusion.
